name: Paulo Freire
shortBio: Brazilian educator and critical philosopher who revolutionized epistemology and political praxis by formulating critical pedagogy, dialogical problem-posing education, and conscientização.
centralQuestion: How can education become the practice of freedom rather than an instrument for the reproduction of oppressive consciousness?

keyWorks.title: Pedagogy of the Oppressed
keyWorks.description: Foundational critique of the banking concept of education, proposing dialogical problem-posing praxis for collective liberation.

keyWorks.title: Education for Critical Consciousness
keyWorks.description: Exploration of conscientização, democratic participation, and the dismantling of internalized fatalism among marginalized communities.

keyWorks.title: Pedagogy of Hope: Reliving Pedagogy of the Oppressed
keyWorks.description: Deep philosophical re-examination of historical possibility, ethical indignation, and affective solidarity.
